g.card: Canza mahadar layin dogo kuma ka jagoranci kowace keken ma’adinai zuwa ƙofar fita mai launinta.
g.genre: Wasan wuyar warwarewa na layin dogo da kekunan ma’adinai
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: wasanin layin dogo 90 a cikin kogon lu’ulu’u 6. Canza mahadar kuma ka jagoranci kowace keke zuwa ƙofar fita mai launinta.
g.h2: Wasanin layin dogo a kogon ɗan ƙaramin mutum
g.p1: Kekunan suna fitowa daga rami suna birgima da kansu. Canza mahadar don kowace ta kai ƙofar launinta ba tare da karo ba.
g.p2: Matakai 90 a kogo 6: lefa, gadoji masu juyawa, ƙanƙara, ruwa mai tashi da lava. Samu taurari 3 da ƙananan motsi, kuma ɗan ƙaramin mutumin yana taimaka maka idan ka makale.
l.card: Juya madubai, jagoranci hasken haske kuma ka sake haskaka zaurukan fada 150.
l.genre: Wasan wuyar warwarewa na madubai da haske
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: juya madubai kuma ka jagoranci haske zuwa lu’ulu’u a matakai 150 da duniyoyi 6 da aka zana.
l.h2: Wasanin haske a cikin fada mai sihiri
l.p1: Fadar ta yi duhu. Juya madubai da zaurukan don jagorantar haske zuwa lu’ulu’u: idan duka suka haskaka, ƙofar zinariya ta buɗe.
l.p2: Matakai 150 a duniyoyi 6: launuka don haɗawa, gilashi mai launi, firizim, mutum-mutumi da giya. Alamu da taurari 3 a kowane mataki ga mafiya wayo.
l.f1: Matakai 150 a duniyoyi 6 da aka zana
l.f2: Madubai, firizim, gilashi mai launi da giya
d.card: Gudu, tashi sama kuma ka tofa wuta ta cikin masarautu 7 masu sihiri da shugabanninsu 7.
d.tag: Gudu, tashi sama kuma ka tofa wuta.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: wasan dandamali na 2D da aka zana da hannu. Ketare masarautu 7, matakai 63 da shugabanni 7 don korar Sarkin Inuwa.
d.p1: Yi wasa a matsayin ƙaramin dodo kore mai jarumtaka. Gudu, tsalle, yawo a sama kuma ka tofa wuta don korar Sarkin Inuwa.
d.p2: Masarautu 7, matakai 63 da shugabanni 7, kowanne da dabararsa. Tara lu’ulu’u kuma ka samu har taurari 3 a kowane mataki.
d.f2: Shugabanni 7 da za a ci, kowanne da dabararsa
t.card: Yanka, juya kuma ka ajiye gizagizai don buɗe hanya ga ƙaramin tela.
t.genre: Wasan wuyar warwarewa na gizagizai da siffofi
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: wasanin 240 a yankuna 12 na sama. Yanka, juya kuma ka ajiye gizagizai don buɗe hanya.
t.h2: Wasan wuyar warwarewa mai natsuwa a sama
t.p1: Tsibirai suna yawo a sama kuma ƙofa mai sihiri tana jira. Yanka gizagizai, juya su kuma ka ajiye su don gina hanyar ƙaramin tela.
t.p2: Matakai 240 a yankuna 12 da aka zana, ba tare da agogo ba. Samu taurari 3, buɗe akwatuna kuma ka tara gizagizai.
t.f2: Mai natsuwa, ba tare da agogo ba
w.card: Saka giya, isar da ƙarfi kuma ka tada masarautar da ke barci.
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: wasanin inji 150 a duniyoyin tatsuniya 6. Saka giya kuma ka isar da ƙarfi don sake kunna injuna.
w.h2: Wasan wuyar warwarewa da giya na gaske
w.p1: La’ana ta daskarar da masarautar. Saka giya a wurin da ya dace don isar da ƙarfin inji mai sihiri kuma ka sake sa injuna su yi aiki.
w.p2: Matakai 150 a duniyoyi 6: rune, lefa, hasken lu’ulu’u da agogon yashi. Samu taurari 3 kuma ka kalli taswirori suna dawo da launukansu.
u.card: Ajiye tubalan rune masu faɗuwa kuma ka haɗa rune masu launi ɗaya don su ɓace.
u.genre: Wasan wuyar warwarewa na tubalan da ke faɗuwa
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: ajiye tubalan rune masu faɗuwa, haɗa launuka kuma ka jera kombo a matakai 180 da yankuna 6.
u.p1: Tubalan rune suna faɗuwa a kan allo. Motsa su kuma ka juya su don haɗa rune masu launi ɗaya: suna ɓacewa kuma komai yana faɗuwa ƙasa.
u.p2: Matakai 180 a yankuna 6, daga Hasumiyar Mai Sihiri zuwa Kagaran Sama. Jera kombo don samun taurari 3.
n.card: Jagoranci dodon, ci rune kuma ka girma ba tare da cizon wutsiyarka ba.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: wasan maciji tare da dodo. Ci rune, kauce wa cikas kuma ka ci masu gadi 6 a matakai 120.
n.p1: Dodon ba ya taɓa tsayawa. Shafa don juya shi, ci rune don girma kuma ka kauce wa bango da jikinka.
n.p2: Matakai 120 a yankuna 6, kowanne shugaba yana gadinsa. Rune masu sihiri suna rage saurin lokaci, suna mai da kai fatalwa ko suna kare ka.
n.f2: Rune masu sihiri masu iko daban-daban
